alt.en: MacGuard keeps the newest verified log checkpoint. A release whose checkpoint is smaller than that, or has a different root at the same size, or grows without a consistency proof, is refused. The trusted state is never moved backwards.
alt.es: MacGuard guarda el checkpoint verificado más reciente. Una release cuyo checkpoint es menor, o tiene otra raíz con el mismo tamaño, o crece sin una prueba de consistencia, se rechaza. El estado de confianza nunca retrocede.
